title: Power Infrastructure Trends Impacting Solar, Storage, and Data Centers
summary: Uncover the latest power infrastructure trends that impact utility-scale solar, battery storage, and data centers today.
body_markdown:
Power infrastructure is entering a new era. AI is driving electricity demand at unprecedented speed. Rapidly expanding data centers, battery energy storage, grid constraints, and the need for faster deployment are changing how power systems are designed and built.


In our latest video, Shoals explores seven trends shaping the next generation of power infrastructure. These trends range from the rise of Bring Your Own Power (BYOP) and[evolving DC architectures](https://shoals.com/en/insights/dc-architectures-in-next-generation-energy-systems/) to speed to power, scalability, reliability, and safety.


At[Shoals](https://shoals.com/en/) , we bring decades of experience simplifying electrical infrastructure. We help developers, asset owners, and EPCs navigate change across utility-scale solar, battery storage, and data centers.
